tool.description: Add, update, or remove DICOMweb sources (user-level)

tool.help:
This tool maintains a user-level DICOMweb sources catalog as a JSON dataset.
Typical workflow: 1) Run this tool to create a catalog and add sources. 2) Use the catalog as input to “Register DICOMReference” and “Fetch Series Copy”. 3) Update/remove sources by re-running this tool on the existing catalog.
